The '''Battle of the Black Hills''' was an early 1952 Nogoyevian offensive during the [[Nogoyevian War of Independence]]. It marked Nogoyev's transition from mainly guerrilla defense toward larger organized conventional operations.

The battle took place in the mountainous southern region of Nogoyev. The terrain favored defenders, but Nogoyevian forces used it offensively by attacking Union positions from several directions.

== Course ==

Nogoyevian forces used captured and refurbished Zhensanovian armor to support the offensive. The source names several tank models, but the exact equipment list should be checked against AGGSWorld technology chronology before final publication.

By the end of the battle, the Union had relinquished control of the southern region named in the source, including the towns of Rzhev, Lunia, and Dmitrog.

== Legacy ==

The battle showed that Nogoyev could do more than survive sieges and conduct guerrilla raids. It gave the independence movement a model for later counteroffensives and strengthened morale after the defense of Migov and Boten.
